levels.surface: رجل يقال له يحيى بن فلان

notes: «رأيت في كتاب عفان حديث هشام» : Hasan's first-person sight of a book, with no transmission verb linking him to Hisham, needs a ruling
«رجل يقال له يحيى بن فلان» is a placeholder name, kept unnamed; Affan is the owner of the book and the one asked, not a relayer of the saying
